WITH quantities AS (
  SELECT order_id,
         AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS order_avg_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY order_id
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS overall_avg_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
)
SELECT q.order_id,
       q.order_avg_quantity,
       q.order_avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_quantity AS average_difference
FROM quantities AS q
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_quantity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY average_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as numeric text; blank or whitespace-only values count as missing, and other values are cast to decimal for averaging.
